title: wg: protocol-06 §4.2/§5.3 AppSync names a superseded mechanism
description: Erratum. §4.2 (L889-903) and §5.3 (L1359-1361) describe changes as "AppSync" proposals (draft-barnes-mls-appsync-01), while §4.3.2, §5.4, §7.5, §7.6 use mls-extensions-10 AppDataUpdate. L1360-1361 also says "applicationId of mimiParticipantList or mimiRoomPolicy"; no such field or registered name exists (components are participant_list 0x0022 and room-policy-04 §10.1). An implementer could pick appsync-01's proposal type and not interoperate. mimid: every AppSync read as AppDataUpdate 0x0008 (decision mimid-1wgh.4.16). Fix: use AppDataUpdate throughout and name the registered components.
